dashboard.action.payroll.authorize.label: Amabaruwa y'imishahara yo gutanga uburenganzira
dashboard.action.payroll.check.label: Amabaruwa y'imishahara yo kugenzura
dashboard.action.payroll.pay.label: Amabaruwa y'imishahara yo kwishyura
dashboard.action.payroll.verify.label: Amabaruwa y'imishahara yo gusuzuma
dashboard.action.pettycash.approve.label: Amafaranga make yo kwemeza
dashboard.action.sales.confirm.descripti: Ibyategetswe byo kugurisha ari inyandiko y'agateganyo
dashboard.action.sales.confirm.label: Ibyagurishijwe byo kwemeza
dashboard.cost.basis: Abakozi (umushahara nyuma yo gukatwa w'amabaruwa arangirira muri iki gihe) + amafaranga make yakoreshejwe yemejwe atari AMAKORANE + ibikoresho byakoreshejwe ku makuru y'akazi yemejwe bibarirwa ku giciro cya nyuma cy'iguriro, bigabanywe kuri blokoyi nziza.
dashboard.kpi.achievement.definition: Blokoyi zakozwe ÷ intego y'igihe cy'akazi × 100 (raporo z'akazi zemejwe).
dashboard.kpi.achievement.label: Ibyagezweho mu musaruro
dashboard.kpi.availability.definition: (Igihe cyateganyijwe − igihe imashini yahagaze) ÷ igihe cyateganyijwe × 100. Igihe cyateganyijwe = iminota {minutes} kuri buri raporo y'akazi yemejwe.
dashboard.kpi.availability.label: Uko imashini iboneka
dashboard.kpi.blocksSold.definition: Ingano iri ku byagurishijwe BYEMEJWE biri muri iki gihe.
dashboard.kpi.blocksSold.label: Blokoyi zagurishijwe
dashboard.kpi.cementPer1000.definition: Imifuka ya sima yakoreshejwe (raporo z'akazi zemejwe) ÷ blokoyi zakozwe × 1,000.
dashboard.kpi.cementPer1000.label: Sima kuri blokoyi 1,000
dashboard.kpi.collected.definition: Amafaranga abakiliya bishyuye muri iki gihe (ibyagurishijwe byemejwe).
dashboard.kpi.collected.label: Amafaranga yakusanyijwe
dashboard.kpi.costPerBlock.definition: (Igiciro cy'abakozi + amafaranga make yakoreshejwe atari AMAKORANE + ibikoresho byakoreshejwe × igiciro cya nyuma cy'iguriro) ÷ blokoyi nziza.
dashboard.kpi.costPerBlock.label: Igiciro kuri blokoyi nziza
dashboard.kpi.good.definition: Zakozwe − izangiritse mu gukora − izangiritse mu kuzitwara − ingero.
dashboard.kpi.good.label: Blokoyi nziza
dashboard.kpi.labourCost.definition: Umushahara nyuma yo gukatwa w'amabaruwa y'imishahara (yamaze gutegurwa cyangwa arenzeho) arangirira muri iki gihe.
dashboard.kpi.labourCost.label: Igiciro cy'abakozi
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashBalance.definitio: Amafaranga yashyizwemo yemejwe − amafaranga yakoreshejwe yemejwe − ikiguzi cya MoMo, kugeza ku musozo w'igihe.
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashBalance.label: Amafaranga make asigaye
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashExpenses.definiti: Amafaranga make yakoreshejwe yemejwe muri iki gihe (harimo ikiguzi cya MoMo).
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashExpenses.label: Amafaranga make yakoreshejwe
dashboard.kpi.produced.definition: Blokoyi zose ziri ku raporo z'akazi zemejwe.
dashboard.kpi.produced.label: Blokoyi zakozwe
dashboard.kpi.quality.definition: Blokoyi nziza ÷ blokoyi zakozwe × 100. Nziza = zakozwe − izangiritse mu gukora − izangiritse mu kuzitwara − ingero.
dashboard.kpi.quality.label: Igipimo cy'ubuziranenge bwemewe
dashboard.kpi.receivables.definition: Ibyagurishijwe byose byemejwe − ubwishyu bwose bwakiriwe, kugeza ku musozo w'igihe.
dashboard.kpi.receivables.label: Ideni ritarishyurwa
dashboard.kpi.rejection.definition: (Izangiritse mu gukora + izangiritse mu kuzitwara) ÷ blokoyi zakozwe × 100.
dashboard.kpi.rejection.label: Igipimo cy'ibitemewe
dashboard.kpi.revenue.definition: Agaciro k'ibyagurishijwe BYEMEJWE biri muri iki gihe.
dashboard.kpi.revenue.label: Amafaranga y'ibyagurishijwe
dashboard.pettycash.balance_basis: Amafaranga make y'ikigo cyose kugeza ku musozo w'igihe (ntiyatoranyijwe ku ruganda).
dashboard.production.availability_basis: Igihe cyateganyijwe = iminota {minutes} kuri buri raporo y'akazi yemejwe.
